fixes.explanation: Sacrifices? Friend, that one's not on the table. The Twelve say, "It is unacceptable for us to neglect the word of God in order to wait on tables." Tables are one job, and the word of God is a different job. They won't let one swallow the other, and I respect that, because I've seen what happens when everything gets piled in one drawer.

Healing? I love the confidence, friend, but that's not in this plan. The Twelve say they "…will devote ourselves to prayer and to the ministry of the word." Healing never makes the list. Prayer is the one standing right next to the word, so that's the pick.
